  SELECT id, name, parent_id, 0 AS depth
  FROM employees WHERE id = 42
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.id, e.name, e.parent_id, a.depth + 1
  FROM employees e

)

  (if (null lst) nil
    (let ((pivot (car lst))
          (rest  (cdr lst)))
      (append
        (quicksort (remove-if-not (lambda (x) (< x pivot)) rest))

using LinearAlgebra
function power_iteration(A::Matrix{Float64}; tol=1e-8, maxiter=1000)
    n = size(A, 1)
    v = normalize(randn(n))
    for _ in 1:maxiter
        w = A * v
        λ = dot(v, w)
        v_new = normalize(w)
        norm(v_new - v) < tol && return λ, v_new
        v = v_new
    end
end

# Bootstrapped confidence interval
boot_ci <- function(x, stat_fn, B = 1000, alpha = 0.05) {
  n <- length(x)
  boot_stats <- replicate(B, stat_fn(sample(x, n, replace = TRUE)))
  quantile(boot_stats, c(alpha/2, 1 - alpha/2))
}
result <- boot_ci(rnorm(100), mean)
cat(sprintf('95%% CI: [%.3f, %.3f]\n', result[1], result[2]))

Theorem add_comm : forall n m : nat, n + m = m + n.
Proof.
  intros n m.
  induction n as [| n' IHn'].
  - simpl. rewrite <- plus_n_O. reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite -> IHn'. rewrite <- plus_n_Sm. reflexivity.
Qed.

content: Shannon entropy H(X) = −Σ p(x) log₂ p(x) measures the average uncertainty in a random variable. The channel capacity C = max_{p(x)} I(X;Y) = max_{p(x)} (H(Y) − H(Y|X)) gives the maximum mutual information achievable.
